name: Business Administration
description: A comprehensive degree covering modern corporate management, finance, marketing strategies, international trade, and organizational leadership. Students develop strategic problem-solving skills required for management roles in global enterprises.
entryRequirements: High school diploma with good grades in mathematics and English. A statement of purpose and letter of recommendation are required.

name: Computer Science
description: An intensive study of algorithms, software development, web systems, database design, and cloud architecture. Prepares graduates to solve complex computing problems and innovate in software engineering and technology sectors.
entryRequirements: High school completion with strong fundamentals in mathematics and logical reasoning, alongside English proficiency.

name: Mechanical Engineering
description: Covers thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, CAD design, robotics, automotive engineering, and materials science. Combines rigorous physical principles with practical engineering laboratory design projects.
entryRequirements: Strong secondary school background in Physics and Advanced Mathematics. Official academic transcripts and English test certificates.

name: Civil Engineering
description: Focuses on structural analysis, transportation infrastructure, geotechnics, urban planning, and sustainable construction practices. Equips students with technical tools to design modern resilient buildings and bridges.
entryRequirements: Completion of secondary education with emphasis on Mathematics and Chemistry or Physics. B2 English proficiency.

name: Data Science
description: An advanced program specializing in machine learning, statistical modeling, big data analytics, neural networks, and business intelligence. Students learn to extract actionable insights from complex unstructured data sets.
entryRequirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related STEM field. Proof of English language competency.

name: Hospitality Management
description: Teaches luxury hotel operations, resort management, event planning, customer experience design, and tourism economics. Blends managerial education with hands-on internship experience in world-class resorts.
entryRequirements: High school leaving diploma, motivation essay, and B2 level English language qualification.
